minor.issue: Session history is truncated to last 8 turns and injected inline into the user message. Works but can hit token limits on long sessions — consider a summarisation pass after N turns.
Creates a new session_id each call (summary-<uid>-<rand>), never persists messages for the summary. Intentional, but means /api/ai/sessions won't show these. Consider persisting or documenting.

action_items: No blocking items. Optional: persist /api/ai/summary output as a message row so it surfaces in /api/ai/sessions.

critical_code_review_comments: ai_assistant.py is clean — async throughout, _id excluded, env-driven key, proper 401/400/500/502 codes, per-user session scoping on GET/DELETE.

Session_id auto-generation uses `f"{user['id']}-{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"` — safe, non-colliding, and bound to user (though messages themselves are also filtered by user_id which is the real scoping guarantee).
LlmChat is instantiated per request which is correct — emergentintegrations LlmChat isn't shared-safe across sessions.
Context builder pulls up to 10k month orders — fine at POS scale; add pagination/limits only if restaurant volume grows >50k/mo.
Frontend AIChatPanel keeps sessionId in component state only — closing the bubble loses continuity. Documented in problem statement; acceptable for MVP.
All interactive AI elements have data-testids (ai-bubble-open, ai-bubble-panel, ai-close-btn, ai-suggestion-[0-3], ai-msg-*, ai-input, ai-send-btn, ai-summary-btn, nav-ai-assistant, ai-page).
